description: Make a fresh copy of an existing draft (version 1) with all of its variants, captions, media and network options, so you can adapt it without rewriting from scratch. TikTok owner choices are cleared so the owner chooses again on the TikTok screen. Posts nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: The draft id to copy, from drafts_list or drafts_get.

title.description: A name for the new draft, up to 200 characters. Left out, the original title with "(copy)" is used.

name: drafts_duplicate
title: Duplicate a draft
